section.para: In this lesson, you will review each strategy learned throughout this unit to assess the best strategy to factor polynomials. You will be presented with different polynomials, and, without additional context, you will find the fully factored form of each.
When you finish this lesson, you will be able to:

list.item: Recognize and use the appropriate method to factor a polynomial completely.

section.para: Here are the activities that will help you reach those goals:

list.item: 6.7.2: Reviewing General Strategies to Factor a Polynomial

section.para: After that, you’ll practice and review.
